result.title: MUPA${}^2$S: Multimodal Unified Perception with Asymmetric Attention for Stress Assessment
result.summary: Stress is a leading contributor to long-term physical and mental health decline. The automatic assessment of stress is a promising approach for continuous monitoring and mitigating human biases. However, the development of automated systems remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of physiological and behavioral signals. This paper presents MUPA${}^2$S, a multimodal framework for automatic stress assessment that combines facial video and ECG signals within a unified perception architecture. Both modalities are mapped into a shared token representation without modality-specific components, and processed through asymmetric attention comprising segment-local cross-attention and global self-attention across segment states. Experiments on a newly collected 58-subject stress dataset, evaluated under a stratified subject-level protocol, show that facial video achieves 69.44% test accuracy, while ECG-only performance remains close to chance under the proposed representation. Unified Video-ECG fusion achieves a test accuracy of 69.58% at approximately half the number of parameters of feature-level fusion, with negligible additional computational cost. Feature-level fusion does not exceed the video-only baseline, while unified input-level integration provides a parameter-efficient mechanism for jointly processing the two modalities.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MUPA²S，将面部视频与 ECG 映射到共享 token 表示，并用分段局部跨注意力与全局自注意力进行自动压力评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是面向压力评估的多模态融合应用，没有涉及 latent 推理状态生成、视觉证据筛选或停止决策；共享 token 与分段注意力结构虽与跨模态状态融合略有形式相似，但缺乏可供核查的 LVR 线索。
